note: Float and fishing access on the North Fork of the White River, at the end of County Road H-354 (gravel) west of Route KK. Three mapped primitive camping spots: a gravel lot by the picnic area at the top of the access, a pull-off beside the paved lot, and the edge of the boat-ramp turnaround near the river. Campfire rings, picnic tables and a privy. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites', three mapped primitive camping spots within ~100 m (one cluster), free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privy added. Pin is on the north camping point. Waterfront lead (not waterfront -> riverview) from the ramp-side spot. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page lists 'Individual Campsites' and 'campfire rings, picnic tables, privy, and concrete boat ramp'. GIS layer 27 has 3 'Primitive Camping Area' points: 324 (36.65532,-92.22969, the stored pin) on the gravel lot by the picnic area (lot 1100), 323 (36.65470,-92.22971) on a gravel pull-off off the paved lane, and 472 (36.65445,-92.22976) at the west edge of the paved boat-ramp turnaround. Imagery: paved lanes and lots inside the access, ~30 m+ gravel/paved lots; reached by CR H-354, gravel from the end of the KK pavement (0.5 mi) - no ford, no posted limit. A 23-ft rig fits the lots. All within ~100 m: one cluster, no split.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront) - lead for riverview: on the 0.12 m/px leaf-off frame camping point 472 is ~17-20 m from the North Fork (~50-60 m wide) across an open gravel/rock bank with a few small trees - an open sightline to the river. Riverfront isn't clearly earned because the spot is the paved boat-ramp turnaround (day-use apron; the ramp itself is ~20 m south). Point 323 is ~35-40 m from the water through a wooded band, and the stored pin 324 is ~80 m back in the woods - no value from either. Lead only - stored value not changed.
PIN: stored 36.65532,-92.22969 = GIS camping point 324 on the north gravel lot - fine (all three points within 100 m).
PHONE: (417) 746-0291 on the area page matches.
